steps.name: tp1day-b13seat
argv: PASS ONE, RELIT. No LoRA -- this plate exists to carry a POSE and a LIGHT, and pass two puts bnyjerry into it. Identical to round six's control cell, which drew a correct h240seat stance, except that the prompt now names the flat overcast daylight the founder's canon frame is lit by. The i2i route re-lights and does not re-ground, so pass two inherits this light -- which is why the mauve skin is fixed here.

steps.name: publish
argv:
import hashlib, glob, os, shutil
OUT = "C:/banyan-farm/lora-jerry-v2-tp1day-0822/out"
DST = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/lora-jerry-v2-tp1day-0822"
os.makedirs(DST, exist_ok=True)
n = 0
found = []
found += sorted(glob.glob(OUT + "/*.png"))
found += sorted(glob.glob(OUT + "/*.png.meta.yaml"))
for p in found:
    if os.path.isfile(p):
        shutil.copyfile(p, os.path.join(DST, os.path.basename(p)))
        n += 1
with open(os.path.join(DST, "lora-jerry-v2-tp1day-0822.sha256"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for name in sorted(os.listdir(DST)):
        q = os.path.join(DST, name)
        if os.path.isfile(q) and not name.endswith(".sha256"):
            fh.write("%s  %s" % (
                hashlib.sha256(open(q, "rb").read()).hexdigest(), name) + chr(10))
print("published", n, "file(s) ->", DST, flush=True)
if n == 0:
    raise SystemExit("NOTHING TO PUBLISH -- the sample produced no files")
